description: Test suite for Mattermost server configuration commands, including get, set, patch, reset, show, reload, and migrate commands, with extensive use of mocks and assertions.

methods.name: TestConfigGetCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config get' command, testing retrieval of various config values and error handling.

methods.name: TestConfigSetCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config set' command, testing setting of various config values and error handling.

methods.name: TestConfigPatchCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config patch' command, testing patching config from files, including error cases.

methods.name: TestConfigResetCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config reset' command, testing resetting individual keys and sections.

methods.name: TestConfigShowCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config show' command, testing config display and error handling.

methods.name: TestConfigReloadCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config reload' command, testing successful reload and error handling.

methods.name: TestConfigMigrateCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config migrate' command, testing migration with and without the --local flag.

methods.name: TestCloudRestricted
methods.description: Unit tests for the 'cloudRestricted' function, checking if config paths are restricted in cloud environments.

methods.name: TestSetConfigValue
methods.description: Unit tests for the 'setConfigValue' function, verifying correct setting of various data types in config.

methods.name: TestConfigExportCmd
methods.description: Unit test for the 'config export' command, ensuring config is exported as-is.
